title: JRN-013 Exception Path EXC-001: Compliance Blocked — Sanctions Hit
description: Exception path where sanctions screening (PH-054) returns a hit on the beneficiary or beneficiary bank. SVC-051 raises an internal compliance alert instead of publishing LCComplianceCleared (EVT-077). LC is blocked — MLRO (PER-058) is notified. No SWIFT MT700 is transmitted. Customer is informed transaction cannot proceed without disclosing the compliance reason (POCA 2002 s.333A tipping-off prohibition).
